primary.estimand: Pre-match focal corrected-policy minus Hold win probability on this fixed matched-availability workload matrix, including no-op cases.
primary.interval: Prospective conservative two-sided95% Hoeffding interval:100*sqrt(2*log(2/.05)/576) percentage points half-width; heterogeneous independent paired streams allowed.

design: 72 fixed profiles,18 contexts,4 independent synthetic templates,8 fresh seeds per profile,balanced original orientation. All native energy initialization, substitutions, recovery, physical coefficients and20-minute halftime unchanged. Stamina8/recovery6 are fixture inputs, not a guarantee of realized halftime energy. Opponent holds; both teams have matched availability counts and roots.
classification: Isolated corrected-policy evaluation. No old outcomes pooled, no winner-based tuning, no target adoption rate, no guarantee of expected benefit or policy optimality. Context/recipe/side/deficit and energy splits descriptive. Cross-match energy carry-over remains out of scope.

readiness.functional: All physical, own-observation, bounds, blocked-lever, first-half, no-op and replay checks pass.
readiness.coverage: Report realized energy distributions and Hold competitiveness. A cohort with no control wins or all control wins cannot establish competitive policy value; disclose without changing its sample.
readiness.decision: Inspect supported choices and contradictions as mechanisms, not hindsight winner labels. A positive point estimate or an interval including zero does not establish benefit, non-inferiority or safety.
readiness.next: If no new structural defect or unaddressed coverage problem emerges, freeze this corrected candidate for holistic research; holistic research is a separate gate and not final release acceptance. Never invent new pass margins from observed outcomes.
